props.text: Can I bring an external optometrist prescription?

props.html: Yes. Signed prescriptions from any licensed practitioner are welcome. During your appointment we still measure individual pupil height, head posture tilt, and vertex distance against the specific titanium silhouette you choose.

props.text: How long does Tokai freeform glazing require?

props.html: Single-vision 1.60 and 1.67 prescriptions are edged and ultrasonically fitted within seven business days. Custom double-aspheric 1.74 or progressive binocular corridors ship from Tokai Japan in ten to twelve days.

props.text: Do high-power minus lenses sit flush inside thin wire frames?

props.html: Pair prescriptions between -5.00 D and -12.00 D with our M-15 Saddle or M-22 Wellington models alongside 1.74 Double-Aspheric resin. Both feature deep milled seats that conceal outer edge steps cleanly.

props.text: What is covered under lifetime Sabae hinge care?

props.html: Every frame receives complimentary annual ultrasonic bath flushing, nose pad replacement, cotton-wheel acetate polishing, and Torx hinge 0.35 N tension recalibration in Kyoto or Antwerp.
